ABBREVIATIONS
JMSDF: Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force
PLAN: People’s Liberation Army Navy (China)
AGI: Auxiliary General Intelligence

The PLAN AGI continued to sail eastward through Osumi Strait into the Pacific Ocean from October 17 to 18.
JMSDF assets monitored the activities of the vessel.

At around 3:00 p.m., Saturday, October 17, 2026, JMSDF spotted PLAN Dongdiao-class AGI x 1 (hull number 798) sailing eastward in the waters approximately 100 km west of Kuchinoerabu-jima Island. https://t.co/cLUILQl7iN
